title: BDP GIS Cloud Transport Infrastructure Data Model
description: Reverse-engineered schema for Bulgarian Road Safety (БДП) municipal transport stop inspection data, hosted on GIS Cloud. Inferred from 10,284 stop records (layer 6542284) and 453 station records (layer 6542289). Each field includes a _confidence score (1-100) and _inference note.

giscloud_envelope.description: Platform-managed wrapper for every GIS Cloud feature record

__id.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing surrogate key assigned by GIS Cloud
__id._inference: Unique across all records, not strictly sequential — shared sequence or gaps from deletions

__owner.description: Foreign key to GIS Cloud user account. Null for bulk-imported records (67.5%)
__owner._inference: Maps 1:1 to user_name in most cases. Null indicates batch/admin import, not field app submission

__created._inference: Present on all records. Represents database persistence time, not physical inspection date

__modified.description: Last modification timestamp (Unix epoch, UTC). Equals __created for 46.1% of records (never edited)
__modified._inference: Changed on any attribute or geometry update. Equal to __created means untouched since creation

__geometry.description: Spatial geometry in EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator). Authoritative coordinate source — longitude/latitude attribute fields are vestigial zeros
__geometry._inference: GeoJSON Point. 10,280/10,284 records have valid geometry. 4 records lack coordinates

administrative_location.description: Bulgarian administrative hierarchy: област → община → населено място

oblast.description: Administrative region (област). One of Bulgaria's 28 oblasts. Lookup value, not free text
oblast._inference: 100% populated, exactly matches Bulgaria's 28 oblasts. 'Софийска' appears in avtogari layer as variant of 'София'

municipal.description: Municipality (община). Strict child of oblast — each belongs to exactly one oblast
municipal._inference: 100% populated, 179 unique values. One name collision: 'Бяла' exists in both Варна and Русе oblasts (correct — two distinct municipalities)

city_vila.description: Settlement name (населено място). Free-text with inconsistent formatting (prefixes 'с.', 'гр.', district qualifiers)
city_vila._inference: 96.3% populated, 748 unique values. Not a strict lookup — entered by inspectors with varying conventions

inspection_metadata.description: Fields recording who performed the inspection, when, and with what device

date1.description: Inspection date (ISO 8601). When the physical site visit occurred. Distinct from __created (database save time)

inspector1.description: Primary inspector name. Free-text — no validation against user directory. Contains person names, initials, institution names, and data quality issues (PDF JSON leaks, joke entries)
inspector1._inference: 77.1% populated, 388 unique values. Independent of user_name — multiple inspectors share one account

inspector2.description: Secondary inspector name. Effectively unused — inspections are single-person
inspector2._inference: 0.3% populated (29 records in spirki, 0 in avtogari). Values are initials or 'не'

user_name.description: GIS Cloud account username. Represents organizational account (municipality), not individual inspector. Convention: {municipality}_municipality
user_name._inference: 77.1% populated, 240 unique. 231/240 tied to single municipality. Exception: 'sars_gov' spans 55 municipalities (central SARS account)

device_id.description: Android device hex identifier from GIS Cloud MDC app. Only populated for mobile field captures
device_id._inference: 7.5% populated, 99 unique hex strings. Some records have PDF JSON leaked into this field (form mapping bug)

accuracy.description: GPS accuracy in meters at capture time. 0 = manual screen placement, 3-10 = typical smartphone GPS, 90 = poor fix
accuracy._inference: 69.4% populated. Mostly 0 (manual) or 3.9-9.6 (auto GPS). Auto-recorded by MDC app, not user-entered

speed.description: Speed at GPS capture time. 0 = stationary. Non-zero suggests capture from moving vehicle
speed._inference: 68.6% populated. Values: 0,1,2,7,8,9,40. Units unclear (km/h or m/s). Auto-recorded by GPS

oneOf.title: TransportStop
oneOf.description: СПИРКИ НА ГРАДСКИ / МЕЖДУГРАДСКИ ТРАНСПОРТ — individual bus stop on the road network

road_n.description: Street/road name. Free-text: street names, road numbers, stop names, landmarks
road_n._inference: 87.4% populated, 2757 unique values. High cardinality confirms free-text entry

road_t.description: Road type. 'улица' (street, 85.2%) = urban stop, 'път' (road, 14.8%) = intercity stop. This is the градски/междуградски distinction
road_t._inference: 100% populated, exactly 2 values. Core classifier for the layer

element_kod.description: Stop code from national register or municipal inventory. Numeric string, near-unique (1 duplicate: '487')
element_kod._inference: 67.5% populated, 6942/6943 unique. Only on inspected records — codes assigned during/after inspection

djob.description: Has bus bay / widening (уширане/джоб)? Dedicated pull-in area separate from traffic lane
djob._inference: 77.1% populated. All-or-nothing with other inspection fields

ogradni.description: Has fencing/barriers (огради)? Protective fencing at the stop

buferni_t.description: Has buffer bodies (буферни тела)? Physical crash barriers or bollards protecting passengers

osvetyavan.description: Has lighting (осветление)? One record uses lowercase 'да' — data entry inconsistency
osvetyavan._inference: 77.1% populated. The lowercase variant confirms no input normalization on this field

znaci.description: Has road signs (пътни знаци)? Proper signage marking the stop for drivers

class_str.description: VESTIGIAL. Unknown classifier, possibly road width class. 0.3% populated. Abandoned field
class_str._inference: 32/10284 non-null. Values: 'до 8м.', 'не', 'Васил Левски' (misplaced street name). Planned but unused

foto1.description: Photo attachment reference. ___json[...] wrapper with GIS Cloud file metadata (pathname, rid, lid, fid). Photos on asset server
foto1._inference: 0.2% populated (25 records). Form supports photos but inspectors rarely attach them

foto2.description: Second photo attachment. Effectively unused (2 records, both 'не')

longitude.description: VESTIGIAL. Always 0. Actual coordinates in __geometry. Form field exists but app ignores it

latitude.description: VESTIGIAL. Always 0. Same as longitude — actual coords in __geometry

_lifecycle.description: Records exist in exactly one of two states. Zero partial records exist — inspection is all-or-nothing

oneOf.title: TransportStation
oneOf.description: АВТОГАРИ / ЖП ГАРИ — bus stations and railway stations

tip_element.description: Station type. Bus station vs railway station

name.description: Station name (e.g., 'Автогара Подуяне', 'ЖП гара Пловдив'). More structured than road_n in stops layer

element_cod.description: Station code. Note spelling difference from spirki 'element_kod' — likely a typo in schema definition
element_cod._inference: 57.8% populated, 200 unique values. No cross-reference to spirki element_kod

znaci_mark.description: Has signs/markings? Equivalent to 'znaci' in stops layer, different field name

osvetyavan.description: Has lighting? Shared with stops layer

data_2.description: UNUSED. Reserved field, never populated. Possibly planned for secondary date

time.description: UNUSED. Possibly planned for inspection time or station operating hours

administrative_hierarchy.description: област (28) → община (179) → населено място (748). Oblast→Municipal is strict 1:N. Municipal→City is loose 1:N (free-text, not FK)

user_ownership.description: GIS Cloud account ID maps to organizational username. 187 owners → 240 usernames (some owners used multiple accounts)

user_municipality.description: 231/240 users tied to single municipality. 9 exceptions: 'sars_gov' (55 municipalities, central SARS), 'sars2' (7), and 7 cross-boundary municipal accounts

cross_layer.description: Spirki and avtogari share a map and base schema but have no FK relationship. element_kod/element_cod values do not cross-reference

data_quality_issues.issue: PDF JSON leaked into text fields
data_quality_issues.cause: Mobile form file-upload widget writing ___json[...] to text fields instead of attachment fields
Form schema includes lat/lon but MDC app writes directly to __geometry
No input normalization on enum field
Free-text entry: casing variants, trailing spaces, abbreviation differences for same person
Likely typo during schema definition — same semantic field with different spelling
